description: This is a Java interface file defining methods for reading post-dated check data within the repayment with post-dated checks service module of the Fineract project.

classes.name: RepaymentWithPostDatedChecksReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface for reading post-dated check data, including retrieving lists of checks and individual check details by ID or installment ID.

methods.name: getPostDatedChecks
methods.description: Retrieves a list of post-dated checks associated with a given ID, possibly representing a loan or account.

methods.name: getPostDatedCheck
methods.description: Retrieves details for a single post-dated check by its ID.

methods.name: getPostDatedCheckByInstallmentId
methods.description: Retrieves a post-dated check associated with a specific installment ID and loan ID.
